## My Assessment

Based on your circumstances, I'm afraid you are currently **not eligible** for Child Benefit for either child at this time. Here's why:

### **Alex (8 years old) - INELIGIBLE**
While you are in the process of adopting Alex and are contributing £30.00 per week towards their upkeep (which is more than the Child Benefit rate), the key requirement is that Alex must **come to live with you** before you can claim Child Benefit. The rules allow you to claim as soon as an adopted child comes to live with you - you don't need to wait for the adoption to be finalized - but they do need to have moved in with you first.

**What you can do:** Once Alex comes to live with you, you will be able to claim Child Benefit immediately, even if the adoption process isn't yet complete.

### **Blake (9 years old) - INELIGIBLE**
Although Blake lives with you (which would normally qualify you), another person who lives with Blake has priority to claim Child Benefit. Only one person can receive Child Benefit for each child.

**What you can do:** If you want to claim for Blake instead, you would need to contact the Child Benefit Office to discuss changing who receives the benefit. The current claimant would need to stop their claim, and then you could make a new claim.

If you have any questions or if your circumstances change (such as when Alex moves in with you), please don't hesitate to reach out!
